svg.title: Known-best packing of 261 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=261 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 2573ff5 rational centre/half-angle certificate in Evan Daniel's format, centres in [0, S]^2, converted from a checkout at the pin whose bytes have the digests the packet records; no upstream byte is retained. Finite construction feasibility only; no local minimum, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.

svg.text: U n=261 known best: side ~ 16.67877988 (certified upper bound)
